english.title: Credit reference agency fail to disclose filed information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a credit reference agency, after receiving a request in writing under section 158(1) of the Consumer Credit Act 1974 from a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF CONSUMER..) failed to

(A)_[give a copy of the file to the consumer within the prescribed period]_
(B)_[give to the consumer, together with a copy of the file, a statement in the prescribed form of the consumer's rights under section 159 of the Consumer Credit Act 1974]_
(C)_[give to the consumer, when no such file was kept, notice of that fact]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 158(4) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a credit reference agency after receiving a request in writing from a consumer
failed to give a copy of the file relating to the consumer particulars reasonably required OR
failed to give to the consumer together with a copy of the file
a statement in the prescribed form of the consumer's rights under s.159 of the Act OR
failed to give to the consumer when no such file was kept notice of that fact

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant being a credit reference agency, failed, after receiving a request in writing from a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF CONSUMER..) for a copy of the file relating to the consumer, particulars reasonably required to identify it and a fee of £2, to

(A)_[give a copy of the file to the consumer within the prescribed period.]_
(B)_[give to the consumer, together with a copy of the file, a statement in the prescribed form of the consumer's rights under section 159 of the Consumer Credit Act 1974.]_
(C)_[give notice to the consumer, when no such file was kept, notice of that fact.]_

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Asiantaeth archwilio credyd yn methu datgelu gwybodaeth wedi'i ffeilio
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n asiantaeth archwilio credyd ac wedi cael cais ysgrifenedig dan adran 158(1) Deddf Credyd Defnyddwyr 1974 gan ddefnyddiwr, sef **(..SPECIFY NAME OF CONSUMER..) bu i chi fethu

(A)_[rhoi copi o'r ffeil i'r defnyddiwr cyn pen y cyfnod a bennwyd]_
(B)_[rhoi i'r defnyddiwr ddatganiad yn y ffurf a bennwyd o hawliau'r defnyddiwr dan adran 159 Deddf Credyd Defnyddwyr 1974, ynghyd â chopi o'r ffeil]_
(C)_[rhoi gwybod i'r defnyddiwr nad oedd ffeil o'r fath, pan nad oedd ffeil o'r fath yn cael ei chadw]_
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a'r diffynnydd yn asiantaeth archwilio credyd, ar ôl iddo gael cais ysgrifenedig gan ddefnyddiwr, sef **(..SPECIFY NAME OF CONSUMER..) am gopi o'r ffeil a oedd yn ymwneud â'r defnyddiwr, manylion yr oedd gofyn rhesymol amdanynt i ddod o hyd iddi a ffi o £2, bu iddo fethu

(A)_[rhoi copi o'r ffeil i'r defnyddiwr cyn pen y cyfnod a bennwyd.]_
(B)_[rhoi i'r defnyddiwr ddatganiad yn y ffurf a bennwyd o hawliau'r defnyddiwr dan adran 159 Deddf Credyd Defnyddwyr 1974, ynghyd â chopi o'r ffeil.]_
(C)_[rhoi gwybod i'r defnyddiwr nad oedd ffeil o'r fath, pan nad oedd ffeil o'r fath yn cael ei chadw.]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 158(4) ac Atodlen 1 Deddf Credyd Defnyddwyr 1974.
